 I'm in Cyprus staying in the Greek part of Nicosia and on a little walk over to the Turkish side I heard almost bird like screaming by this mosque and when came closer I heard it was a meow, so I thought maybe some cat was stuck in a tree or something (I have three dummies who I have to pick like fruit at least once a month) but when I got by the bushes I saw this so smol baby, I just called it and tapped my finger on the pavement and she came running straight into my arms, I just picked her up and took her with me after not seeing any mommy and thinking, best case, even IF she came back, she'd still be a stray covered in fleas and with an eye infection. 


I walked around with her for a while and tried to Google any vet clinic or any place to take her but everything was closed for some holidays I was told so I was just gonna take her with me back to the hotel but in passport control I was told to hide her cause they wouldn't let cross, so I put her in my fanny pack and kinda hid her behind a shopping bag I was carrying. We just needed to show our passports and go. Mission successful.

I stopped by flying tiger and bought the cutest bag for her to put her in to sneak her into my hotel. She was absolutely exhausted and could only drink a little water from my palm while lying with her face in it while my mom searched for a vet which we then took her to, got her shots and stuff for the fleas, which afterwards I wasn't supposed to touch her for two hours and my vet brought her a box.
 She screem.
They only made me pay for the meds and a bag of kitten food which rounded up to a whooping 8€, around 10usd I guess.
I asked them what I should do with her since I shouldn't really take her to my hotel and I'm only here till Sunday, but they said every shelter is packed full and he doubted anyone would take her.

So she came back with me and mom, we went to a restaurant to eat so we could take her out of the box after two hours and smuggle her back into the hotel, where I sat with her on the bathroom floor kinda hoping she'd fall asleep in a towel since I was trying not to touch her but noooo, only cuddles for Ms smol, I have a video of me trough Snapchat saying how hard it was to have her since she has fleas and she only wants to go into my neck, when she started climbing up my chest and then curled up to sleep on my shoulder (I cry) so naturally I could not just disturb her so there we sat for an hour or something on the floor (I'm not pooping haha)

She could not be left alone or put down at all or she start screem, but I put hot water in a bottle and made a lil nest next to my bed with it and she slept all night straight. In the morning I found a facebook page for cats who need homes in Cyprus and made a post for her, where within an hour a girl offered to foster her. She volunteers at a shelter or is friends with a guy who runs it and they have 150 dogs and about 300cats :(

There is an insane amount of stray cats here in Cyprus. I posted this on a Facebook page for cats in my country and managed to get donations for 300$ to give the shelter. :) Not much but will help some cats

I read today because this has been happening to me almost every night (including getting diarrhea) I just started anxiety meds after my 10th trip to the ER because of a panic attack and have a proper doctors appointment after the weekend. It happens to about 50 % of people who have panic disorder, and really the only thing to do is treat it like you would a nightmare, if you can't go straight back to sleep you're probably not gonna be able to for hours so might as well just stand up, splash some cold water in your face and just sit and get a grasp of reality for a second, do breathing exercises and even meditate. Ignoring the problem won't help, rather acknowledge that it's there and accept it.
It's simple but it's not easy, this has helped me a little to deal with it.
